plugins.name: video-learning-tutor
plugins.description: Turns a YouTube video into a guided learning session: fetches the transcript through the datafrom YouTube connector, installed automatically as a dependency, and tutors you through it with grounded, cited explanations.

plugins.name: datafrom
plugins.description: datafrom.io connectors for Claude Code. Adds the YouTube MCP server for video metadata and timestamped transcripts; sign in with OAuth in /mcp.
